title: Record the coefficient-width bounds
body:
## Summary
- At precision and frequency 1, the coefficient routine has initial height 27 and working precision 115.
- For every larger positive pair, the working precision is below five times the height, the block count is at most half the working precision, and the width exponent is at most `-P-83`.
- All 1,600 pairs through 40 meet the same bounds. The selected κ is unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/coefficient-width-bound/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/coefficient-width-bound/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/coefficient-width-bound`
- [ ] Maintainer replay from the pinned base commit
